# R4a evals — Real-account screens in the browser (Playwright harness, synthetic data)

> Base for every diff check is the literal token `$(git log -1 --format=%H -- docs/build/evals/R4a.md)` (substituted before running). Run all commands from the worktree root under bash or zsh. Source of truth: R4a spec (R4a.1 to R4a.4). Written from the spec, not from the builder's code. No database, no paid API, no network beyond localhost. Do not print `.env*`.
>
> Every Playwright command uses its own port and own server: `KV_E2E_PORT=3312 npx playwright test e2e/real-screens.spec.ts ...`. Shorthand: `C=playwright.config.ts`, `A=e2e/real-account.ts`, `S=e2e/real-screens.spec.ts`.
>
> Harness checks (R4a-08 to R4a-10): PASS needs exit 0 and output matching `[0-9]+ passed` with no `skipped`, `failed` or `did not run`. Titles go to `-g`; they contain no regex metacharacters.
>
> Calm checks (R4a-11): a product-rule failure there is a FINDING to report (failing test, measured numbers, screenshot path), NOT a FAIL of the task. The task FAILS only if the test did not run properly (skipped, timeout waiting for a fixture, 404 on a fixture path, other harness error) or if a failure message does not name a measured rule.

## A. Scope and config

R4a-01. Changed plus untracked paths are a subset of the three R4a.1 rows; src, tests, package files unchanged — cmd: `{ git diff --name-only $(git log -1 --format=%H -- docs/build/evals/R4a.md); git ls-files --others --exclude-standard; } | sort -u | grep . | grep -vxE 'playwright\.config\.ts|e2e/real-account\.ts|e2e/real-screens\.spec\.ts'; echo "stray-done"; git check-ignore -q test-results playwright-report || echo "NOT-IGNORED: test-results or playwright-report count as stray if present"; git diff --stat $(git log -1 --format=%H -- docs/build/evals/R4a.md) -- src tests package.json package-lock.json | wc -l | tr -d ' '; test -s e2e/real-account.ts && test -s e2e/real-screens.spec.ts && echo files-exist` — expect: nothing before `stray-done`, no `NOT-IGNORED` line unless those dirs do not exist, then `0`, then `files-exist` — PASS if no path outside the three rows changed or is untracked (ignored `test-results/` and `playwright-report/` are skipped by `--exclude-standard` only when `git check-ignore` confirms them; otherwise they count as stray), `src`, `tests`, `package.json`, `package-lock.json` are unchanged, and both new files are non-empty.

R4a-02. playwright.config.ts reads KV_E2E_PORT, default 3201, reuse off when set, mock adapters kept — cmd: `C=playwright.config.ts; grep -q 'KV_E2E_PORT' $C && grep -q '3201' $C && grep -q 'reuseExistingServer' $C && grep -q 'NEXT_PUBLIC_ADAPTERS=mock' $C && echo config-strings-ok; grep -n 'reuseExistingServer' $C; git diff $(git log -1 --format=%H -- docs/build/evals/R4a.md) -- $C | grep -E '^[-+]' | grep -vE '^(\+\+\+|---)'` — expect: `config-strings-ok`, then a `reuseExistingServer` line whose value depends on `KV_E2E_PORT` (not a bare `true`), then a small diff touching only port, baseURL, command, url and reuse lines — PASS if `KV_E2E_PORT` is read, `3201` is the default, `reuseExistingServer` is false when `KV_E2E_PORT` is set and true otherwise, `NEXT_PUBLIC_ADAPTERS=mock` is still in the command, and no other setting changed in the diff.

## B. Harness file

R4a-03. real-account.ts pinned strings present — cmd: `A=e2e/real-account.ts; for s in 'export async function asRealAccount' 'page.route("**/api/app/**"' '"backend"' 'Asha Rao' 'Example Insurer' 'Example Health Plan 01' 'unhandled' 'NOT_FOUND' '404' 'h1' 'renewal_date'; do grep -qF -- "$s" $A || { echo "MISSING $s"; exit 1; }; done; echo account-strings-ok` — expect: output `account-strings-ok` — PASS if all 11 strings are in `e2e/real-account.ts`.

R4a-04. real-account.ts is synthetic only, never fulfils /api/v1 — cmd: `A=e2e/real-account.ts; grep -nE 'sk-[A-Za-z0-9]{10,}|AIza[0-9A-Za-z_-]{20,}|AKIA[0-9A-Z]{12,}|eyJ[A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,}|Bearer [A-Za-z0-9._-]{16,}|[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[a-z]{2,}' $A | grep -vE '@(example\.com|company\.com)\b'; echo keys-done; grep -n '/api/v1' $A; echo v1-done` — expect: nothing between the start and `keys-done`, nothing between `keys-done` and `v1-done` except lines that are a comment or an assertion that `/api/v1` is NOT served (no `fulfill` on a `/api/v1` path) — PASS if no key-like string, no e-mail domain other than `example.com` or `company.com`, and no `/api/v1` response is fulfilled.

## C. Spec file

R4a-05. The 11 titles verbatim — cmd: `S=e2e/real-screens.spec.ts; for s in 'home shows the cover sentence and one next step for a real account' 'home is calm at 1440x900 and 1280x800' 'my policies shows one card per policy and no pager for two' 'five policies page at four' 'my policies is calm at 1440x900 and 1280x800' 'policy detail opens on At a glance and switches to a fact group' 'a group of nine facts pages at eight' 'policy detail is calm at 1440x900 and 1280x800' 'the wizard is calm on every step at 1440x900' 'under 1024px wide the laptop gate shows and the app is hidden' 'no call reaches the backend API and no app call is unhandled'; do grep -qF -- "$s" $S || { echo "MISSING $s"; exit 1; }; done; echo titles-ok` — expect: output `titles-ok` — PASS if all 11 titles appear verbatim in `e2e/real-screens.spec.ts`.

R4a-06. expectCalm has the four rules, terms exemption, screenshots path — cmd: `S=e2e/real-screens.spec.ts; grep -qE '(function|const) expectCalm' $S || { echo "MISSING expectCalm"; exit 1; }; for s in 'scrollHeight' 'clientHeight' 'innerHeight' 'fontSize' 'fontWeight' '16' '500' 'main' 'data-panel="terms"' 'test-results/real/' 'asRealAccount' 'Get access' '/welcome'; do grep -qF -- "$s" $S || { echo "MISSING $s"; exit 1; }; done; echo calm-strings-ok` — expect: output `calm-strings-ok` — PASS if `expectCalm` is defined and all 13 strings are present (scroll rules on document and `main`, font-size 16 and font-weight 500 thresholds, `[data-panel="terms"]` exemption, screenshots under `test-results/real/`, beta sign-in then `/welcome`).

R4a-07. No skipped, focused or pending tests, assertions not weakened — cmd: `grep -nE 'test\.skip|test\.fixme|test\.only|\.only\(|describe\.skip|test\.slow|expect\.soft' e2e/real-screens.spec.ts; echo skip-done; grep -c "^[[:space:]]*test(" e2e/real-screens.spec.ts` — expect: nothing before `skip-done`, then `11` — PASS if no skip, fixme, only or soft-assert is present and exactly 11 `test(` declarations exist.

## D. Run

R4a-08. Harness tests 1 and 3 and 4 pass (home sentence, two-policy list, five policies page at four) — cmd: `for t in 'home shows the cover sentence and one next step for a real account' 'my policies shows one card per policy and no pager for two' 'five policies page at four'; do KV_E2E_PORT=3312 npx playwright test e2e/real-screens.spec.ts -g "$t" --reporter=line 2>&1 | tail -15; echo "rc=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"; done` — expect: each run prints `1 passed` and `rc=0` — PASS if all three titles show `1 passed` with `rc=0` (run under bash; under zsh use `${pipestatus[1]}`; a zero-match run is FAIL).

R4a-09. Harness tests 6 and 7 pass (detail opens on At a glance and switches group, nine facts page at eight) — cmd: `for t in 'policy detail opens on At a glance and switches to a fact group' 'a group of nine facts pages at eight'; do KV_E2E_PORT=3312 npx playwright test e2e/real-screens.spec.ts -g "$t" --reporter=line 2>&1 | tail -15; echo "rc=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"; done` — expect: each run prints `1 passed` and `rc=0` — PASS if both titles show `1 passed` with `rc=0` (run under bash; under zsh use `${pipestatus[1]}`).

R4a-10. Harness tests 10 and 11 pass (laptop gate under 1024px, no /api/v1 call and no unhandled app call) — cmd: `for t in 'under 1024px wide the laptop gate shows and the app is hidden' 'no call reaches the backend API and no app call is unhandled'; do KV_E2E_PORT=3312 npx playwright test e2e/real-screens.spec.ts -g "$t" --reporter=line 2>&1 | tail -15; echo "rc=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"; done` — expect: each run prints `1 passed` and `rc=0` — PASS if both titles show `1 passed` with `rc=0`; test 11 passing proves `unhandled` is empty and no `/api/v1` request was made.

R4a-11. Calm tests 2, 5, 8, 9 ran and any failure names a measured rule — cmd: `for t in 'home is calm at 1440x900 and 1280x800' 'my policies is calm at 1440x900 and 1280x800' 'policy detail is calm at 1440x900 and 1280x800' 'the wizard is calm on every step at 1440x900'; do echo "=== $t"; KV_E2E_PORT=3312 npx playwright test e2e/real-screens.spec.ts -g "$t" --reporter=line 2>&1 | tail -40; done; ls test-results/real/ 2>/dev/null` — expect: per title either `1 passed`, or `1 failed` whose message names a measured rule (mentions `scrollHeight`, `clientHeight`, `innerHeight`, `font-size`, `fontSize`, `font-weight` or `fontWeight` with numbers); PNG files appear under `test-results/real/` — PASS if every title ran (no `skipped`, no `did not run`) and no failure is a harness error (no `Timeout` waiting for a fixture or locator that is a fixture, no 404 or `NOT_FOUND` on a fixture path, no TypeError in `e2e/`); a failing calm test with a measured-rule message is a FINDING to report (test, numbers, screenshot path), not a FAIL of this check.

## E. Gates and cleanup

R4a-12. Typecheck passes — cmd: `npm run typecheck >/dev/null 2>&1; echo "rc=$?"` — expect: `rc=0` — PASS if exit code is 0.

R4a-13. Lint passes with no file listed other than src/app/layout.tsx — cmd: `npm run lint 2>&1 | tee /dev/stderr >/dev/null; npm run lint 2>&1 | grep -E '^/|^[./a-zA-Z0-9_-]+\.(ts|tsx|js|mjs)' | grep -v 'src/app/layout.tsx'; echo "other-files-done"; npm run lint >/dev/null 2>&1; echo "rc=$?"` — expect: nothing between the lint output and `other-files-done`, then `rc=0` — PASS if lint exits 0 and no file path other than `src/app/layout.tsx` appears in its output (in particular no `e2e/` file).

R4a-14. No server left on port 3312 — cmd: `lsof -ti :3312; echo "lsof-done"` — expect: output is exactly `lsof-done` — PASS if no process id is printed before it (run after R4a-08 to R4a-11 finished; the config must not leave a dev server behind).
